invariants.rationale: The data list is used in the method, so it must not be null at method exit.
The consumer is wrapped and used, so it must not be null at method exit.
Parallelism typically represents a positive level of parallel execution, and 0 or negative values are unlikely to be meaningful.
The stream view of the list should have the same number of elements as the list size at method exit.
After forEach, all elements should remain, as forEach does not remove elements from the original list.
